svg.title: Public SPA · tokens in browser memory
svg.desc: Popup login keeps the React page and its PKCE transaction alive.
svg.text: Public SPA · tokens in browser memory
Popup login keeps the React page and its PKCE transaction alive.
Browser sends state and an S256 PKCE challenge to Keycloak.
Popup callback relays the result to the original React page.
Redeem the code from the React page
Send the code + PKCE verifier to the token endpoint; no client secret.
Keep the issued tokens in memory
The React page receives access, ID and refresh tokens.
GET /orders or POST /orders with Authorization: Bearer <access token>.
Orders validates the token and checks user / manager permissions.
OAuth tokens stay in JavaScript memory.
and audience; then enforce realm roles.
Solid arrows: requests • Dashed arrows: responses / browser callbacks
